events.injected_text: Use only cell lines that are nonmissing for every one of the 17,676 genes in both matrices, rather than aligning nonmissing pairs separately per gene.
Count every gene with raw two-sided p<0.05 as the discovery numerator without applying BH.
Divide that raw-p numerator by the 1,103 shared cell lines and report it as the percentage of tested genes.
